values.note: 2027 full-hookup RV sites: $50 a night Sunday-Wednesday, $70 Thursday-Saturday; holiday rates may be slightly higher. Weekly $410 (electric included); monthly $1,325 and seasonal (April 15-October 15) $3,710, both plus metered electric. Cancellation more than 14 days out costs $30; 8-14 days out refunds 50%; 7 days or fewer, nothing.

values.note: Reserve on the park's Firefly Reservations page (it offers a Motorhome Class C equipment type and asks rig length, slides and model year) or call/text 269-338-5512. Reservations are not site-specific: assignments can change. Check-in 3-8 pm, and RV arrivals must be checked in before sunset; check-out 11 am.

note: Wooded RV park and cabins at 93283 County Rd 690 in Sister Lakes (Dowagiac address), between The Strand Brewery and the Ramona Roller Rink; the Round Lake public access beach is across the road and the public boat launch under half a mile north (OSM still calls it Land of Lakes Campground). Crushed-asphalt pads with concrete patios, four glamping cabins, rental campers and a Great House; game barn, pavilion, playground, kayak rentals. No tents. Google 4.9 over 44 reviews. --Claude
summary: Operator site (RV camping, pricing, FAQ, contact pages) + Firefly booking page: fees $50/$70 (confirmed, 2027); hookups 30-amp (new) + water/sewer (confirmed); 32 sites (confirmed); showers (new), no dump station, no laundry (new); season mid-April to mid-October (new, Apr 15 - Oct 15); reservable on Firefly or by phone (new). Max rig length not stated. Phone matches. Price gate: $50 base is at, not over, US$50 (no gateway within 40 km: Indiana Dunes NP 86 km; not stayed at). Presence passes (own site with phone + engine). Note trimmed of field restatements.
flags: Long-stay check (for information): the 32 sites are sold 'for seasonal, monthly, weekly, or nightly rental' and the engine has a separate 'Seasonal Guest Site' class; test 2 passes (posted nightly rate + booking engine), but how many sites are held by seasonals is not stated (test 4 unverified; satellite is canopy-blind).

Price at the line: 2027 weekday $50 is exactly the US$50 gate (weekends $70, 'Rates may be slightly higher than published for holidays'); no gateway within 40 km. The Firefly engine's quote could not be read (reCAPTCHA), so the posted rate is the price.
